title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Cola Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Cola Ice delivers the unmistakable taste of classic cola with an icy twist. The rich caramel and spiced vanilla notes of a fizzy cola drink are perfectly balanced by a wave of cooling Menthol, creating a refreshing and nostalgic vape with a crisp, frosty finish. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Cola Ice is designed to replicate the punchy, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting depth of flavour while providing a smooth and satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been a recognised leader in e-liquid craftsmanship, offering expertly developed blends that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to premium ingredients and distinctive flavour profiles continues to make them a favourite among vapers.
